model_output.rationale: All three therapy lines (97110, 97112, 97140) denied CO-4 + N822. None carry GP/GO/GN. Chart note confirms PT services under a PT plan of care. Medicare Part B (MB). Remedy: new original claim with GP on every line. Filing clock runs from DOS 2026-01-13; 1-year limit is 2027-01-13.

root_cause.explanation: 97110, 97112, 97140 billed with no GP/GO/GN modifier. Payer returned CO-4 + N822 (missing required modifier) on all three lines. Chart note confirms outpatient PT plan of care requiring GP.

next_action.detail: Submit a NEW original claim (CLM05-3=1, no REF*F8) appending modifier GP to each of the three therapy lines. Do not send frequency 7 — Medicare Part B does not accept it. Act before 2027-01-13.
